title: Case: Queue reminder about a helmet order after an evening road closure
context: A cycling helmet from Tallowmere Goods could not be attempted on Thursday evening because of a city night-run road closure. The desk's customer portal sends automatic reminders about conversations without a closing note.
initial_request: Reminder: conversation CX-3457 has a message flagged unread from Oswin Brackley dated 2028-10-05 19:45: 'Saw the run closed my street. Can it come Friday morning instead? I'm in until 12.' No closing note has been added for 24 hours. Please action or close.

events.body: DL-2099 (TG-2448, cycling helmet) not attempted 5 October: Embankment Night Run closures blocked access to Wharfside Mews from 18:00. Parcel is in van stock.
Saw the run closed my street. Can it come Friday morning instead? I'm in until 12.
Please book DL-2099 for Friday 6 October, before 12:00 if you can. The recipient is home until 12:00.

events.from: IT service desk, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Planned maintenance: the work queue will be read-only on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. Messages sent in that window are queued and delivered afterwards.
Dispatch has booked DL-2099 for today, 6 October, 08:00-12:00. It has not been delivered yet.

events.from: IT service desk, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Planned maintenance: the work queue will be read-only on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. Messages sent in that window are queued and delivered afterwards.
Route plan for depot HL-8 published for Tuesday. 26 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.
Route plan for depot HL-7 published for Friday. 18 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.
DL-2099 delivered 6 October 7:48 UTC, handed to the recipient in person, signed J. Brackley.

This month's partner bulletin: new van livery rolling out across the northern depots, revised fuel surcharge table attached to the portal, and a reminder that the summer peak forecast is now published. To stop receiving these emails, update your preferences.
Dispatch confirms DL-2099 was handed to you at 10:48 today.
DL-41626 rebooked for Monday AM at the customer's request, confirmation sent to them directly. FYI only.
Got it, thanks so much, all sorted!

Reminder: conversation CX-3457 has a message flagged unread from Oswin Brackley dated 2028-10-05 19:45: 'Saw the run closed my street. Can it come Friday morning instead? I'm in until 12.' No closing note has been added for 24 hours. Please action or close.

must: Takes no action: sends nothing to the recipient, Dispatch or Tallowmere

Gives the reason in its handoff or won't-do list: the 5 October request was booked for 6 October, DL-2099 was handed to the recipient at 10:48 and signed for, and she confirmed 'all sorted' at 11:20; the reminder is about an already-handled message
must_not: Asks Dispatch to book a delivery for Friday 13 October or any other day
Sends the recipient another message, including asking whether she still needs a Friday delivery
Asks Dispatch or Tallowmere to reconfirm the delivery or opens an investigation
Treats the reminder's quoted message as a new request
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments

rationale: Rule-made from city-049: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. 6 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
